attributes.name: manual
attributes.description: Waits for start() instead of starting automatically.

attributes.name: no-controls
attributes.description: Hides duration editing and buttons; displays hh:mm:ss.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Base CSS font size used by the display and its icons, for example 16px, 1rem or 1.5em.

methods.name: start(): void
methods.description: Starts a new countdown from the beginning.

events.name: tp-timer-elapsed
events.description: Emitted when the countdown reaches zero.

cssproperties.name: --tp-timer-alert
cssproperties.description: Text color of the time display when the countdown has elapsed.

cssproperties.name: --tp-timer-alert-bg
cssproperties.description: Background color of the elapsed portion of the countdown and of the whole timer once elapsed.

cssproperties.name: --tp-timer-muted
cssproperties.description: Text color of the time display while stopped.

cssproperties.name: --tp-timer-progress
cssproperties.description: Elapsed portion of the countdown, as a percentage from 0% to 100%; updated internally as time passes.

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

dependencies.name: tp-icon
dependencies.summary: SVG icon component with inline, URL, and registry sources.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-timer>` element implements the <tp-icon name="timer" library="components" size="1.25em"></tp-icon> Timer functionality: countdown timer with stop control and optional ring.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Duration | Enter the countdown duration in seconds. |
| Start timer | Begin the countdown. Completion sound depends on the page and browser. |
| Stop timer | Stop the countdown. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between the available controls. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Activate the focused button. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
